intentAndPurpose.intent: Choose one or many values, or invoke an action, through a composed input, button, or icon-button trigger and an anchored menu.

forbids: nested interactive controls inside an option
using presentation state to control popup visibility (use open)
assuming contextMenu=false creates responsive or sheet behavior
decorative popup strokes on the elevated Surface

rules.name: trigger
useWhen: selectableButton for labeled actions or compact pickers
selectableIconButton only when an aria-label supplies the name

rules.name: menuType
useWhen: actions for onAction without selection state

rules.name: placement
useWhen: menuDirection "-" for the Figma default anchored-below placement
below, above, or alignWithTrigger only when placement is intentional
menuAlignment and menuSize fill to match an input trigger

rules.name: contextMenu compatibility
useWhen: false currently retains the anchored popup because no alternate false hierarchy or BottomSheet composition is evidenced
deprecated showContextMenu normalizes to contextMenu and does not add responsive behavior

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent role. `auto` inherits the nearest Surface appearance and falls back to `primary` at the page root.

props.name: contextMenu
props.description: Figma authoring signal for the anchored menu presentation. The inspected source defines only the default `true` composition. `false` is accepted but uses the same warned anchored fallback because no BottomSheet/alternate hierarchy is evidenced.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for an uncontrolled single Select.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: Initial values for an uncontrolled multi Select.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Empty state when the Select has no options.

props.name: filled
props.description: Figma SelectableInput axis — whether the input trigger uses filled (high) styling. When unset on interactive `<Select>`, derived from selection (`value` / `values`).

props.name: groups
props.description: Figma grouping axis. Explicit false flattens supplied sections.

props.name: inputStart
props.description: Figma `start` preset when `start` node is not provided.

props.name: menu
props.description: Deprecated compatibility menu behavior using the established single/multi/actions vocabulary. Use `menuType`; it wins on conflict.

props.name: menuAlignment
props.description: Menu alignment; omission resolves by trigger, and the default input uses fill.

props.name: menuDirection
props.description: Figma placement; `-` normalizes to automatic placement below.

props.name: menuMinWidth
props.description: Floor for the menu's width, as a CSS length. The menu normally sizes from `menuSize` or the trigger. Neither works for a deliberately tiny trigger — a swatch-sized control anchors a menu too narrow to read its own options — and the `menuSize` steps are coarse. This sets a minimum without dragging every other menu of that size with it.

props.name: menuSize
props.description: Menu width; omission resolves by trigger, and the default input uses fill.

props.name: noResultsMessage
props.description: Search empty state when no option matches.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Deprecated compatibility callback invoked after a single-select value changes. Use `onValueChange`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Alias for controlled single-select updates (Figma / Base UI naming).

props.name: onVoiceSearch
props.description: Enables Search's trailing voice action when the product supplies voice-search behavior.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for Search visibility. Use `showSearch`; it wins on conflict.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder shown by the canonical Search inside the menu.

props.name: showContextMenu
props.description: Deprecated published-description alias. Use `contextMenu`; it wins on conflict. `false` uses the same anchored fallback and does not enable responsive behavior.

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Show Search in the menu header.

props.name: state
props.description: Figma trigger presentation — `idle`, `active`, or `feedback`. This does not control menu visibility; use `open` for that.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Figma trigger surface. Legacy internal spellings remain accepted.

Actions Menu

  aria-label="Document actions"
  trigger="selectableButton"
  triggerLabel="Actions"
  menuType="actions"
  options={actions}
